تستمجدوا (form X)
# تَسْتَمْجِدُوا (tastamjidū) /tas.tam.d͡ʒi.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
# تُسْتَمْجَدُوا (tustamjadū) /tus.tam.d͡ʒa.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
